bio.text: Fredrick Love, a Democrat, is the Democratic nominee for Governor of Arkansas in 2026 and has represented District 15 in the Arkansas State Senate since January 2023.
Love served in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 29, from 2011 to 2023.

Love earned a bachelor's degree (1999) and a master's degree in public administration (2004) from the University of Arkansas at Little Rock, and worked as director of community services for Pulaski County government.
